# dsh-brief

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that gives
your agent **one tool**: `brief_fetch`. It gathers today's raw

tech-briefing entries —
Hacker News front page + recently-created high-star GitHub repos — and the a

gent writes
your morning digest from them.

The division of labor is the point: **the plugin fetches what the model cannot reach;
the model does

the summarizing.** Public web APIs only, no background polling, no
scheduled jobs — the tool runs w
hen you ask for a brief.

## Use
Just ask, in any session:
> 来一份今天的技术晨报 / give me today's tech brief

The agent calls `brief_fetch`, gets the raw entries, and writes the digest. Ask it to
